clips.title: The story
paras: Witch Hill is a dreary, mist-shrouded rise in the heart of Dustwallow Marsh along the path toward Theramore. It is best known for the secluded Swamplight Manor, scattered camps of hostile Mirefin murlocs, and sinister rumors of dark hauntings.

Rising out of the stagnant waters of Dustwallow Marsh, Witch Hill sits roughly a third of the way along the peninsula leading southeast toward Theramore Isle. The elevated ground provides little refuge from the hazards of the swamp, as aggressive Mirefin murlocs claim the surrounding waters. At its center stands Swamplight Manor, the lonely and unsettling residence of the hermit known as 'Swamp Eye' Jarl. Travelers passing through frequently report eerie phenomena and lingering dark presences across the knoll.
